claims.claim: A READY plan binds the verified checkpoint, old feature head, current remote main, unchanged remote review head, and prospective merge tree.
claims.passCondition: Real Git fixture facts produce a digest-verifiable READY plan and any bound-field tamper fails verification.
claims.primarySurface: real temporary Git fixture with asserted plan fields
claims.counterevidence: a changed head, main, tree, checkpoint, or digest still verifies
claims.observedEvidence: selftest exact-field assertions and tamper case
claims.namedSeam: immutable object preparation writes object database entries but no ref, index, or worktree state

claims.claim: Planning does not move HEAD or the current branch and does not change the index or worktree.
claims.passCondition: branch, HEAD, and porcelain status are identical before and after real planning
claims.primarySurface: before/after Git inspection in a real temporary clone
claims.counterevidence: any ref, index, or worktree delta
claims.observedEvidence: selftest before/after branch, HEAD, and status assertions plus live PR #33 NO_CHANGE plan with visibleGitStateBeforeAfterMatch=true
claims.namedSeam: unreachable immutable objects are intentionally outside visible state

claims.claim: Equivalent exact inputs produce the same local merge commit.
claims.passCondition: two independently cloned review branches produce the same merge commit, tree, and parents
claims.primarySurface: two real Git clones with fixed merge metadata
claims.counterevidence: different merge commit identifiers for the same parents and tree
claims.observedEvidence: selftest compares independent merge commit identifiers and receipt fields
claims.namedSeam: repeatability assumes compatible Git merge semantics

claims.claim: A prospective merge conflict is typed and held before application.
claims.passCondition: a real conflicting history yields HELD plus MERGE_CONFLICT while HEAD and status remain unchanged
claims.counterevidence: conflicting input yields READY or changes visible repository state
claims.namedSeam: a later external state change invalidates the plan and is refused by digest reprobe

claims.claim: Application creates no remote branch or pull-request write.
claims.passCondition: remote branch receiver SHA remains the old checkpoint head and source contains no push or GitHub write invocation
claims.primarySurface: remote ls-remote receiver observation before/after apply
claims.counterevidence: remote review branch advances or a push/PR-write command is invoked
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: host source scan and contract inspection
claims.observedEvidence: selftest remote receiver assertion plus source command scan
claims.namedSeam: the separate publisher owns later remote transport

claims.claim: The adapter has no main, merge-acceptance, promotion, roots, or CANON authority.
claims.passCondition: contract, plan, and receipt all keep those effects false and no matching write command exists
claims.counterevidence: an authority field becomes true or a prohibited write path exists
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: runtime command trace and receipt verification
claims.namedSeam: Mike/AXM and platform Axiom/Mir retain acceptance and stewardship seats
